limitations: Uses synthetic fixtures rather than clinical cases.
Evaluates architecture behavior, not clinical correctness or patient outcomes.
Does not call RxNorm, OpenFDA, or Anthropic.
Writes clearly labeled synthetic evaluation rows to the configured database.
Duplicate medication handling is evaluated only for duplicate finding prevention; the pair-count metric can include a same-RxCUI self-pair.

fixtures.drug_c_name: Evaluation Drug With No Stored Interaction
fixtures.label: eval-a09da3e65b

scenarios.expected: A stored DDI row produces a finding.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The prototype deterministically returns a DDI fixture stored in its database.
scenarios.name: deterministic_ddi_from_stored_row

scenarios.expected: Medications entered in reverse order still match one canonical DDI row.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: Canonical RxCUI ordering prevents A/B and B/A from producing separate DDI findings.
scenarios.name: canonical_drug_pair_ordering

scenarios.expected: The inactive medication is not counted or checked.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The orchestrator excludes medication rows where is_active is false.
scenarios.name: inactive_medication_exclusion

scenarios.expected: The active placeholder medication is excluded from check counts and DDI pairs.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: Unresolved placeholders do not participate in deterministic interaction checking.
scenarios.name: placeholder_drug_exclusion

scenarios.expected: The placeholder remains stored in the patient medication list while excluded from checks.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The architecture preserves unresolved input for review without treating it as a verified interaction-check concept.
scenarios.name: placeholder_visible_but_excluded

scenarios.expected: DDSI is absent before the matching patient condition is recorded.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The DDSI query avoids surfacing the fixture when the matching condition is absent.
scenarios.name: ddsi_absent_without_active_condition

scenarios.expected: DFI appears for an active drug even when the patient has no condition rows.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The prototype treats DFI lookup as drug-based rather than condition-gated.
scenarios.name: dfi_independent_of_condition_profile

scenarios.expected: Findings are ordered from higher to lower severity.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The returned fixture findings are ordered by the implemented severity priority.
scenarios.name: severity_ranking

scenarios.expected: Different assertion severities set sources_conflict=true.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The summary flags disagreement between stored source severities; it does not adjudicate which source is clinically correct.
scenarios.name: source_severity_conflict_flag

scenarios.expected: Both source assertions retain source, raw severity, source ID, and raw payload.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The schema preserves multiple source assertions and their provenance for the fixture interaction.
scenarios.name: source_assertion_preservation

scenarios.expected: The completed check run is stored with the checked medication snapshot.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The prototype persists a run-level record of the non-placeholder active medications evaluated.
scenarios.name: check_run_persistence

scenarios.expected: The finding stores run-time severity, source list, and conflict state.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The fixture finding retains selected run-time fields for later review.
scenarios.name: finding_snapshot_persistence

scenarios.expected: Findings exist with no LLM explanation requested.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: Interaction findings are created independently of the optional explanation layer.
scenarios.name: findings_exist_before_llm_request

scenarios.code_evidence: app/services/orchestrator.py canonical pair set and database interaction query
scenarios.expected: A duplicate active medication row does not duplicate the canonical DDI finding.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: Duplicate medication rows did not duplicate the fixture finding. The current pair-count metric may still include a same-RxCUI self-pair, so this is not evidence of complete duplicate-medication normalization.
scenarios.name: duplicate_medication_does_not_duplicate_finding

scenarios.expected: An active normalized drug with no stored interaction does not create a finding.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The checker does not infer missing interactions from an LLM or external label service.
scenarios.name: missing_database_interaction_creates_no_finding

scenarios.expected: DDSI appears after adding the matching active condition.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The DDSI fixture is returned when its matching condition is active for the patient.
scenarios.name: ddsi_present_with_matching_active_condition

scenarios.expected: DDI major, DDSI moderate, and DFI minor are returned in severity order.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The three fixture interaction types follow the implemented severity ordering.
scenarios.name: severity_ranking_with_three_interaction_types

scenarios.expected: DDSI is absent after the patient condition receives a resolved date.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: Resolved conditions are excluded from the DDSI fixture query.
scenarios.name: ddsi_absent_after_condition_resolution

scenarios.expected: An override row is persisted for an existing finding.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The prototype persists override metadata for later review.
scenarios.name: override_persistence

scenarios.expected: The overridden interaction remains an unsuppressed finding in a later check.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: Current overrides are audit records and do not automatically alter future check behavior.
scenarios.name: override_does_not_suppress_future_finding

scenarios.expected: An acknowledgment below the current major severity does not suppress the DDI.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The implemented comparison resurfaces a finding when current severity exceeds the stored acknowledgment severity.
scenarios.name: acknowledgment_severity_escalation_behavior

scenarios.expected: An acknowledgment at current severity marks the DDI suppressed without deleting it.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: Acknowledgment changes presentation state while preserving the finding in the result and database.
scenarios.name: acknowledgment_suppression

scenarios.expected: A nonexistent finding is rejected before explanation generation.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The explanation endpoint is structurally tied to persisted findings and cannot start from an arbitrary drug pair.
scenarios.name: llm_explanation_requires_existing_finding

scenarios.expected: Core checking completes when the LLM explanation function is replaced with a failing sentinel.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: The deterministic check path does not require Anthropic; this does not evaluate explanation quality.
scenarios.name: anthropic_not_required_for_core_checking

scenarios.expected: Core checking completes when OpenFDA citation fetching is replaced with a failing sentinel.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: OpenFDA is optional explanation context, not a source of interaction existence.
scenarios.name: openfda_not_required_for_core_checking

scenarios.code_evidence: app/services/orchestrator.py consumes stored RxCUIs and does not call normalize_drug_name
scenarios.expected: Core checking completes when normalization is replaced with a failing sentinel.
scenarios.manuscript_safe_interpretation: Once medications are normalized and stored, the check path does not require a live RxNorm call.
scenarios.name: rxnorm_not_required_at_check_time
